LONG rather NARROW high-forehead OBLONG-OVAL face, high gently curved cheekbones with modest shallow cheeks; LONGER lower face with straight tapering jaw and a NARROW ROUNDED-POINTED chin. Moderately WIDE-spaced ordinary deep horizontal almond eyes, broad dark almost-straight RESTING eyebrows without central contraction. HIGH prominent fairly LONG slender straight to gently convex nose bridge, medium narrow blunt downward-rounded tip. Medium width naturally CLOSED lips, full dark medium horizontal moustache with mostly level ends, a SHORT-MEDIUM NARROW dark pointed chin beard and sparse fine jaw hair. Natural fine forehead/eye wrinkles. Own reference supplies long high-nose and narrow lower face geometry; remove brow glare. Distinct from Wang Kang short flat square chin/short wide nose/close eyes, Wang Qi fuller long oval/broad round chin and Wei or Wang Ji broad rectangular jaw; Wang Wei sharply inward hollow hexagon face is different from this gently curved long face. ORIGINAL LOW MATTE DULL BRONZE-DARK IRON round helmet with simple curved narrow side guards, no plume, purple jewel or ornate crest. Plain DARK BROWN-BRONZE small lamellar plates over fitted MUTED DARK OCHRE sleeves, grey-brown lower robe, pale cream cross-collar, simple brown leather wrists and belt, dark trousers and field boots. EXACTLY ONE belt-attached fully SHEATHED sword at one hip, never drawn, no extra hilt/dagger. Commander administration, river supplies and rear deployment, no caricature of boasting or sly rivalry. 长窄椭脸、高曲颧、较宽眼距、高长稍凸鼻与长窄下脸圆尖颏，中短窄颏须；低钝铜铁盔、褐铜小片甲、暗赭贴袖。

画幅：1024×2560，全身立绘，真实透明背景。
场景含义：透明全身人物立绘，完整头饰至双脚，自然稳定站姿。

Weight settled, entire low helmet/both hands/whole hem/both full boots inside generous margins; ONE fully sheathed attached hip sword, genuine alpha.
